ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $\angle AOB$ is a right angle, $OB$ bisects $\angle COD$, $\angle AOC=62^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle AOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB$ is a right angle,\\
it follows that $\angle AOB=90^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle BOC=\angle AOB-\angle AOC=90^\circ-62^\circ=28^\circ$.\\
Since $OB$ bisects $\angle COD$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOD=\angle BOC=28^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle AOD=\angle AOB+\angle BOD=90^\circ+28^\circ=\boxed{118^\circ}$.
